blind.description: A garden sundial consisting of a stepped square stone pedestal base, a fluted baluster shaft, and a circular stone top holding a bronze sundial plate with radiating hour lines and an upright triangular gnomon. Surfaces are solid and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating pieces. The model sits flat on its integrated stone base. Textures represent weathered sandstone with faint green moss in crevices and an aged bronze or brass plate.
blind.from_above: A circular stone ring encircling a round bronze dial plate with radial hour divisions, bisected by a straight-edged gnomon that casts a dark shadow across the upper face.
blind.height_vs_figure: Approximately half the height of the figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall) and about 1.5 feet wide across the circular top and base.
